//: No build, output or function configuration here on purpose. @astrojs/vercel emits the
Build Output API config (.vercel/output/config.json) itself — routing, the prerendered
pages and the one on-demand /api/search function. Declaring any of that here would
override the adapter and drift out of step with astro.config.mjs.
Framework Preset, Build Command and Output Directory live in the Vercel project settings.
What remains are response headers, which the adapter does not set.
